title: Core cover-relative effacement
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a family U of opens covering X and an abelian sheaf F, there is a short exact sequence T with T.X₁ = F. The quotient map is surjective on every nonempty U-tuple intersection, the first arrow restricts to a split monomorphism on each U_i, and every Čech connecting map [def-pc-cech-comparison-system] is surjective. No scheme Y, map Y → X or inverse-image conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Agent-written product, local splitting and Čech contraction paragraphs of the node proof, in the comparison context of Stacks Tags 01EQ and 01FD; not a statement of Tag 01FD.

proof.text: Set E_i = (j_i)_*(F|U_i), E = product_i E_i and f = the family of restriction-adjunction units. Projection to E_i followed by the restriction counit retracts f on U_i by the triangle identity. A section in the kernel of f vanishes on the cover, hence is zero by sheaf uniqueness. Thus f is monic. This is the explicit product construction in the source node; no data is chosen from a mere existence theorem.

Take Q = cokernel f and the cokernel short exact sequence. Exact open restriction and the retraction split it on U_i. Restrict the quotient section to any tuple intersection contained in U_i to obtain sectionwise surjectivity. The empty index case forces X empty and the same sequence has only zero sheaves.

For the Čech complex with coefficients E_i, define the degree-lowering homotopy by inserting i at the front of every tuple. E_i(W)=F(W intersection U_i), so insertion does not change the section domain. In dh+hd the face deleting i is the identity and all other faces cancel in pairs. Take products of these homotopies to get zero positive cohomology for E. The long exact homology sequence of the tuplewise short exact Čech complexes makes each connecting map surjective. See the full formula and argument in the theorem docstring.

theorem exists_cechCoverRelativeEffacement_core
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ∃ (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})),
      T.X₁ = F ∧ ∃ (hT : T.ShortExact)
        (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
          Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l))))),
        (∀ i, IsSplitMono ((U i).sheafRestrict.map T.f)) ∧
        ∀ q, Function.Surjective (TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q)
